svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print the insole outline (one smooth curve, no corners) full size

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the insole layout picture; this model is about EU 42.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay the print on the EVA and cut round it with a sharp knife on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cutting mat: one pass with the blade upright, no sawing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Motor hole: 10.6 mm round, centred 120 mm from the heel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 16 mm to the inner (big-toe) side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Punch it with an 11 mm hole punch or cut it with a knife.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lead notch: 4.4 mm wide, from the hole 4.5 mm toward the heel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing else is cut. The hole goes right through: the motor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stands in it, 0.1 mm clear of the shoe's floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay it in the shoe; it lies flat with no edge curling up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the side of the shoe. Trim the outline if it does.
